##: Unpacks the NSIS installer rather than running it, so the app is self-contained under
the Scoop dir and uninstall is a directory removal. The `#/dl.7z` fragment makes Scoop
extract the installer on download; pre_install then unpacks electron-builder's
$PLUGINSDIR/app-64.7z payload into the app dir. Same shape as extras/obsidian.
